fields.title: 📖 A single dip shows the truth of the dunyā
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ reported that the most comfortable person of the dunyā among the people of the Fire will be dipped once into the Fire and will then say that he never saw any good.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The dunyā can seem long, yet before the ākhirah its enjoyment disappears. The intelligent person does not sell the eternal for what is brief.

immutable.source: 📝 Muslim, Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, Kitāb Ṣifat al-Qiyāmah wa-l-Jannah wa-n-Nār, Bāb: Ṣabgh Anʿam Ahl ad-Dunyā fī an-Nār.
